list.name: topic
list.label: Topic
list.query:
import "influxdata/influxdb/schema"
schema.tagValues(bucket: v.defaultBucket, tag: "topic", predicate: (r) => r._measurement == "mqtt_raw", start: -24h)

panels.title: Raw MQTT messages
panels.description: Verbatim tail of tms/#, legacy/#, status/# from the mqtt_raw wire capture — no json_v2 parsing, so this is exactly what was published. The single MQTT connection now carries the 1 Hz heartbeat too; use the Topic variable above to filter it out and focus on the interesting rows.

targets.query:
from(bucket: v.defaultBucket)
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "mqtt_raw" and r._field == "value" and r.topic =~ /${topic:regex}/)
  |> sort(columns: ["_time"], desc: true)
  |> limit(n: 200)
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "topic", "_value"])
  |> rename(columns: {_time: "Time", _value: "payload"})

panels.title: Message rate by topic
panels.description: Messages per window on each MQTT topic, from the mqtt_raw wire capture. Respects the Topic variable above.

targets.query:
from(bucket: v.defaultBucket)
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "mqtt_raw" and r._field == "value" and r.topic =~ /${topic:regex}/)
  |> group(columns: ["topic"])
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: count, createEmpty: false)

panels.title: Messages (last 1 m)
panels.description: Raw MQTT messages captured across all topics in the last minute (ignores the Topic variable — always a whole-connection total). ~30 is healthy (1 msg/2s, now including the 1 Hz heartbeat). 0 means the consumer or broker is down.

targets.query:
from(bucket: v.defaultBucket)
  |> range(start: -1m)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "mqtt_raw" and r._field == "value")
  |> group()
  |> count()
